title: Grandma’s Story: The Two Seeds
moral: Be brave and take chances to grow.

scenes.text: Grandma tells a story about two seeds.
scenes.image_prompt: grandmother telling story to kids at night cartoon

scenes.summary: One seed is brave, the other is afraid.
scenes.text: One seed wants to grow, the other is scared.
scenes.image_prompt: two seeds underground thinking differently cartoon

scenes.text: The brave seed grows into a plant.
scenes.image_prompt: small plant growing out of soil cartoon

scenes.text: The second seed stays under the soil.
A bird eats the seed that never tried to grow.
scenes.image_prompt: bird picking seed from ground cartoon

story: Two seeds faced a choice—one grew with courage while the other stayed afraid and was lost. Grandma teaches that courage helps us grow.
